en: A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a panoramic view of a city district heavily damaged by fire. Many buildings are roofless or burned out, streets are filled with debris, and the overall scene depicts widespread destruction. Printed captions in French and English describe the scene as a general view of the city after the fire of 18–19–20 August. The word "Salonica" appears prominently, along with French "Salonique". A small number "20" appears at the start of the caption, and there is a publisher mark or logo on the lower right.
